title: LiveRunArtifacts
description: Minimum artifact set a live run must emit for a later evaluation.live.reconcile() to be possible. See evaluation/live.py and 2026-08-05-hl-paper-evaluation.md for the failure mode this schema prevents recurring: uptime, signal fidelity, slippage, funding, and exceptions being unreconstructable after the fact.

trade_ledger.description: One row per closed trade: entry/exit time, pair, side, realized P/L.

signal_log.description: Per-bar signal state, so 'same-OHLC signal fidelity' is checkable after the fact.

fill_log.description: Fill price vs. signal price per execution, for realized slippage.

funding_payments.description: Funding events with rate and notional, for realized funding impact.

uptime_samples.description: Periodic bot-alive heartbeats, for uptime percentage.

exception_log.description: All raised exceptions during the run, for a complete exception audit.
